Looking at the group: 15, 32, 5, 13, 82, 7, 1

First, I need to identify the odd numbers:
- 15 (odd)
- 32 (even)
- 5 (odd)
- 13 (odd)
- 82 (even)
- 7 (odd)
- 1 (odd)

The odd numbers are: 15, 5, 13, 7, 1

Adding all the odd numbers: 15 + 5 + 13 + 7 + 1 = 41

Since 41 is an odd number, not an even number, the answer is False.
